title: Walk the old town of Vilnius: from Cathedral Square to the Gate of Dawn
description: A walk through the old town from Cathedral Square past the grand dukes’ palace, the university, and Town Hall Square to the Gate of Dawn, with stops for chocolate, cheese, and local beer.

title: The Artistic Republic of Užupis: Inside Europe’s Bohemian Micronation
description: A walk along the Vilnelė river into Užupis, past its bridges, public art, the Angel of Užupis, and the Constitution, to Bernardine Cemetery and the new Paupys district.

title: Alternative Vilnius
description: A bike tour beyond the old town, from Lukiškės Square past the street art of the Open Gallery and the old Halės market, on bike paths around the city.
